initial_application: No git commit explicitly mentions FHIR-18996. The matching active-source application appears in commit 6b194abc4481facfe7741251817be993161ddbb8, which added CatalogEntry v2 mappings including CatalogEntry.effectivePeriod to MFE-3; immediately before removal, the active CatalogEntry StructureDefinition still contained that mapping.
additional_context: FHIR-28177 later removed CatalogEntry from the current core build, and the combined branch already contains a FHIR-28177 no-change audit commit. Current source/fhir.ini has no active catalogentry or entrydefinition entry, source/catalogentry is absent, and the remaining source/entrydefinition files are stale and out of build scope.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit with no source changes because editing the stale EntryDefinition spreadsheet would not affect the current FHIR specification.
